title: Paper 1 additions: cheap baselines and cut sensitivity for locked U (planted 1 mm)
U_frozen: locked U and its win are unchanged; nothing here can retune U, e>0.25, count>=10, radial_4, or the C isotonic map
sessions: same six (3 development, 3 confirmation); same eligible mask and 1 mm event as the U paper

baselines.direction: higher score = predicted mover; AUROC reported as computed (no flipping)
baselines.B_lowcount: -C0_ij (low-count edges move more in relative terms)
baselines.B_boundary: -mean over the edge's streamlines of min(end-a, end-b) distance in mm from endpoint voxel centre to nearest DKT label boundary (6-neighbour label change, incl. background)
baselines.B_unlabeled: fraction of the edge's endpoints whose nearest voxel is label 0 (needed the 4 mm radial search)
baselines.B_short: -mean endpoint-to-endpoint Euclidean distance (mm) of the edge's streamlines
baselines.C2_F: C2 leakage F if work/C2 finished (planted y only)

metrics: same for U on the same mask

sensitivity_grid.what: recompute U, e, moved, mask from the stored 18 planted maps at each grid point; report Spearman/AUROC; 0.25/10 is the locked primary

not_possible_here.SIFT2_event: planted maps are count-only; a SIFT2 version needs re-assignment with per-streamline weights (not stored in A6)
not_possible_here.second_atlas: needs a second parcellation in DWI space
